name: Bartleby's Mug
summary: In Stormwind, a stubborn brawler keeps Bartleby's Mug close. A warrior must win it in a tavern brawl, then watch Bartleby drain his drink before he surrenders it.

sections.title: A Brawler's Prize
sections.body: Bartleby keeps his mug close, and a young warrior in Stormwind must wrest it from him. The stubborn brawler gives it up only after a fight leaves him beaten. Even then, Bartleby drains every last drop before handing over the mug as proof of victory.

faq.q: What is Bartleby's Mug used for?
aliases: why do i need bartlebys mug
faq.answer: A warrior takes Bartleby's Mug as proof of victory in a training trial. Bringing it to the drill instructor shows the warrior could defeat a stubborn tavern brawler and make him surrender it.
Bartleby owns the mug. The belligerent drunk spends his time drinking and brawling, and gives it up only after an aspiring warrior beats him in a fistfight. He finishes his drink first.

aliases: who do i give bartlebys mug to
faq.answer: Burlguard asks for Bartleby's Mug. The warrior trainer in Stormwind watches the brawl and requires the mug as proof before continuing the warrior's martial education.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you earn Bartleby's Mug by wrestling it from him. The fight calls for grit and force when words fail.
